verdict.rationale: Maritime documents long-lived execution environments: each agent can get its own always-on micro-VM with persistent storage, plus an always-on add-on that keeps an agent running around the clock. That supports long-running agent workloads. However, agents sleep when idle by default, and no documented session-duration limits or hours/days guarantees exist for a single running task. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of maximum continuous session/task runtime (hours or days), confirmation that a long agent task stays running without idle sleep interrupting it on the default plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-hour or multi-day runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep a sandbox session running for hours or days for long agent tasks
